messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: time-based refreshes
parts:
Is it as easy as it sounds to slide time-based refreshes into one of the refactors? As in "refresh iff at least x seconds have passed since the last refresh"? The default of refreshing every 100 iterations is too frequent to be useful for "easy" models, particularly when they are estimated in parallel.

Ben

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] time-based refreshes
parts:
I don't think that would be too hard. ctime should be
portable, but we've said that before and been burned by
Windows (and more recently by Intel).

- Bob
